items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: When the revolution happened Castro lied to everyone. We all know that.

ctx.x: Can you tell me what the conversation around the dinner table was like leading up to that?

Well it didn’t start at the dinner table, it started while I was in a car with my dad. And my dad would make house – he was a doctor so he was making house visits. And sometimes I would go with him, for whatever reason. And Castro was over there when Mr. Castro or whoever is in power now speaks everybody listens. Nothing else happens. The radio, everything is on the speaker. It’s like big brother you know. The speakers are in the street. And he was doing a speech, and he says, “From now on the men from the age of…
not taught in the island” “Well what is that?” “He wants to be a Catholic priest. He wants to be in the clergy.” Yeah. “Oh okay, well granted.”
